title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cornell University
description: A guide to the essential late-night food stops and study sanctuaries that define the after-hours experience for Cornell students in Ithaca.

cards.title: Louie's Lunch
cards.subtitle: North Campus Food Truck
cards.notes: Visit this historic food truck parked near Risley Hall for late-night subs, burgers, and milkshakes. It has served the Cornell community since 1918.
cards.short_summary: A landmark food truck on North Campus serving hot sandwiches and shakes until 3:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie's Lunch is open Monday through Saturday from 5:00 PM to 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Monday-Saturday; closed Sundays.

cards.title: Nasties (Bear Necessities)
cards.subtitle: Robert Purcell Community Center
cards.notes: Head to the RPCC for the 'Nasties' grill, a North Campus staple for late-night mozzarella sticks and breakfast sandwiches using Big Red Bucks.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining and convenience hub for students living on North Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bear Necessities in Robert Purcell Community Center is open until 2:00 AM during academic sessions.
cards.source_title: Commencement Weekend Dining 2026 | Student & Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Standard academic hours typically extend to 2:00 AM daily.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: Collegetown Calzones
cards.notes: Order a custom calzone at this Collegetown favorite, known for staying open well past midnight for delivery or pickup on College Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night calzone specialist located in the heart of Collegetown.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough at 408 College Ave has online ordering hours until 3:50 AM.
cards.source_title: D.P. Dough 408 College Ave - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for late-night orders until 3:50 AM daily.

cards.title: Shortstop Deli
cards.subtitle: Home of the Hot Truck
cards.notes: Visit this downtown deli to try the legendary Hot Truck pizza subs, a Cornell tradition moved from its original truck to this 24/7-style location.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ithaca deli serving the famous Hot Truck French-bread pizza subs.
cards.evidence_claim: Shortstop Deli is open until 10:00 PM daily and serves authentic Hot Truck pizza subs.
cards.source_title: The Legendary Hot Truck - Ithaca - Shortstop Deli
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily; formerly 24 hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweets
cards.notes: Stop by for warm cookies and milk in Collegetown. This spot is a go-to for students pulling all-nighters or looking for a midnight dessert.
cards.short_summary: A bakery in Collegetown specializing in warm cookie delivery until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies in Ithaca offers delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Carpenter Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Engineering Study Space
cards.notes: Access this quiet study space on the Engineering Quad any time of night using your Cornell ID card. It features computers and group study areas.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study facility for Cornell students located within the Engineering Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor main reading room in Carpenter Hall is open to Cornell students via ID card 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Engineering Library - Cornell University
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for current Cornell students with ID card.

cards.title: Clark Hall Study Space
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Science Quad Study
cards.notes: Utilize the second-floor study space in Clark Hall for late-night sessions. It remains accessible whenever the building is open, typically 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour quiet study area located on the second floor of Clark Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Clark Physical Sciences Library study space is available 24/7 on the second floor of Clark Hall.
cards.source_title: Study Space - Clark Physical Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Study space is open 24/7 most days of the year.

cards.title: Jack's Grill
cards.subtitle: Stewart Avenue Burgers
cards.notes: Order burgers, wings, and fries from this Stewart Avenue spot. It is a frequent choice for late-night delivery among students in West Campus and Collegetown.
cards.short_summary: A late-night grill on Stewart Avenue offering a variety of burgers and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack's Grill at 310 Stewart Ave has online ordering hours until 12:40 AM.
cards.source_title: Jack's Grill 310 Stewart Ave - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for orders until 12:40 AM daily.

cards.title: Luna Inspired Street Food
cards.subtitle: Global Late-Night Eats
cards.notes: Try tacos, bao buns, or poutine at this Stewart Avenue location. It offers a diverse menu of street food favorites available for late-night pickup.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual restaurant serving global street food with late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Luna Inspired Street Food at 310 Stewart Ave is open for online ordering until 12:30 AM.
cards.source_title: Luna Inspired Street Food - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for orders until 12:30 AM daily.

cards.title: Duffield Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Social Study Hub
cards.notes: Gather in the spacious atrium of Duffield Hall for late-night group projects. The glass-walled space is a central hub for engineering students at all hours.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern atrium on the Engineering Quad that serves as a 24-hour study and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: The atrium of Duffield Hall is open 24/7 for student use.
cards.source_title: Duffield Hall Space and Reservation System
cards.access_notes: Atrium is open 24/7; individual seminar rooms require reservations.
